channel.title: Fable Tour — Travel in Iraq: stories and guides from Mesopotamia
channel.description: Fable Tour's Iraq travel blog: guides to the archaeological sites, cities and landmarks of Mesopotamia, with practical tips from a local guide.

item.title: The Ishtar Gate of Babylon: history and what you can still see in Iraq
item.description: Visit the Ishtar Gate in Babylon, Iraq: its bulls and dragons, the journey to Berlin, the original foundations on site and tips from a local guide.

item.title: The Imam Hussein Shrine in Karbala: history, what to see and how to visit
item.description: Visit the Imam Hussein Shrine in Karbala, Iraq: its history, the golden dome, Bayn al-Haramayn, getting there from Baghdad and a local guide's tips.

item.title: The Imam Ali Shrine in Najaf: history, what to see and how to visit
item.description: Visit the Imam Ali Shrine in Najaf, Iraq: its history, the golden dome and courtyard, getting there from Baghdad, dress code and a local guide's tips.

item.title: Babylon, Iraq: a complete guide to visiting Nebuchadnezzar's city
item.description: How to visit Babylon in Iraq: history, the Ishtar Gate, the Lion of Babylon, the Processional Way, getting there from Baghdad and a local guide's tips.
